description: Live price-impact quote for a Solana token swap: routed through Jupiter (the same aggregator real swaps use) across every pool it knows about, not a single-pool estimate. Use when user asks "how much slippage will I eat swapping X tokens?" or "what will I actually get if I sell N tokens?". Returns: outputAmount, priceImpactPct, effectivePrice, marketPriceUsd, liquidityUsd, routable (false + error if the size can't be routed at all).

amount.description: Amount of the token to swap, in human units (not raw base units)

mint.description: Solana mint address of the token being sold (base58)

name: workflow.run_swap_price_impact
